notices: Start with Ada and two chickens. Try the Lumberjack example, then write your own roles.

roles.name: Lumberjack
roles.source:
# Bring logs back, keeping one hand for the axe.
loop forever:
    walk to the barn
    store everything
    grab an axe
    walk to the nearest tree
    if i can reach it:
        chop it down
        pick up nearby items
